QTI BWPROF SCMI Driver

The QTI BWPROF SCMI Driver is responsible for monitoring bandwidth counters on
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. (QTI) chipsets. These counters represent the
read/write traffic on DDR memory initiated by various masters. The driver
supports multiple sampling modes, allowing users to configure different
sampling periods for different masters. This enables fine-grained bandwidth
profiling across time intervals. The collected data is exposed to userspace.

[First Level Nodes]
Required properties:
- compatible:		Must be "qcom,bwprof-scmi".
- reg:			Base address and size of the memory-mapped region.
- reg-names:		Must be "mem-base".
- mboxes:		Mailbox reference used for SCMI communication.

[Second Level Nodes]
Required properties:
- compatible:		Must be "qcom,bwprof-hw".
- qcom,hw-type:		Integer specifying the hardware type which should be
			BWPROF_DDR or BWPROF_LLCC depending on which traffic
			is profiled
- qcom,bus_width:	Width of the bus in bits.

[Third Level Nodes]
Required properties:
- compatible:		Must be "qcom,bwprof-sampling-mode".
- qcom,sample-period:	Sampling interval in milliseconds.
- qcom,master-list:	List of master IDs (8-bit values). Supported
			master-list are as below depending on the HW support
			on the target.
			For BWPROF_LLCC - LLCC_CPU,LLCC_GPU,LLCC_TOTAL,
			LLCC_CAMERA,LLCC_DPU, LLCC_EVA,LLCC_VPU and LLCC_PCIe.
			For BWPROF_DDR - DDR_CPU,DDR_GPU, DDR_TOTAL,DDR_CAMERA,
			DDR_DPU,DDR_EVA, DDR_VPU and DDR_PCIe.

-Optional properties:
- qcom,hist-enable:	Boolean property to enable histogram mode.

Example:

	bwprof_scmi: qcom,bwprof-scmi {
		compatible = "qcom,bwprof-scmi";
		#address-cells = <1>;
		#size-cells = <1>;
		ranges;
		reg = <0x17D0B000 0x1000>;
		reg-names = "mem-base";
		mboxes = <&rimps 2>;

		bwprof_ddr: ddr {
			compatible = "qcom,bwprof-hw";
			qcom,hw-type = < 0 >;
			qcom,bus_width = < 16 >;

			bwprof_ddr_1ms: 1ms {
				compatible = "qcom,bwprof-sampling-mode";
				qcom,sample-period = < 1 >;
				qcom,master-list = /bits/ 8 < 50 51 >;
			};
			bwprof_ddr_10ms: 10ms {
				compatible = "qcom,bwprof-sampling-mode";
				com,sample-period = < 10 >;
				qcom,master-list = /bits/ 8 < 50 51 >;
			};
			bwprof_ddr_100ms: 100ms {
				compatible = "qcom,bwprof-sampling-mode";
				qcom,sample-period = < 100 >;
				qcom,master-list = /bits/ 8 < 50 51 52 >;
			};
			bwprof_ddr_hist: Hist {
				compatible = "qcom,bwprof-sampling-mode";
				qcom,sample-period = < 1 >;
				qcom,master-list = /bits/ 8 < 50 51 52 >;
				qcom,delta-enable;
			};
		};
	};
